verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Adaptive Telemetry, which cuts telemetry costs by aggregating data. That is cost reduction, not visibility into observability spend, attribution to teams or services, or alerts on usage spikes before billing. The 'Cost management' spend tracking applies to LLM usage being monitored, not to the user's own observability bill, so it does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can see what my observability spend is, attribute it to teams or services, and catch usage spikes before the bill
